desc: Handheld co-op (an AYN Odin held sideways: its built-in controller in port 1 and the touch controls, both player 1's; the playtest: the built-in controls moved to player 2 and co-op turned itself on): a second controller is nobody until its Start, then player 2 in port 2 while the built-in one and the touch controls stay player 1, whichever player 1 uses; player 2 walks and hops the partner, every hop back to standing; a seat swap asked in player 2's menu, said yes to on the touch A, then back; controller 2 switched off: one player again, the built-in controller still player 1
